list.name: service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM otel.logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
SELECT count() FROM otel.logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND SeverityText IN ('ERROR','FATAL')

panels.title: Log Volume by Service Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName, count() AS log_count FROM otel.logs WHERE Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime AND ServiceName IN ($service) GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, SeverityText, count() AS log_count FROM otel.logs WHERE Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime AND ServiceName IN ($service) GROUP BY time, SeverityText ORDER BY time

SELECT ServiceName, left(Body, 120) AS message, count() AS occurrences FROM otel.logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND SeverityText IN ('ERROR','FATAL') AND ServiceName IN ($service) GROUP BY ServiceName, message ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT Timestamp AS time, ServiceName, Host, SeverityText AS level, Body AS message FROM otel.logs WHERE Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime AND ServiceName IN ($service) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT count(DISTINCT TraceId) FROM otel.traces WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
SELECT count() FROM otel.traces WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND StatusCode = 'ERROR'

panels.title: P50 / P95 / P99 Span Duration by Service (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName, quantile(0.50)(Duration)/1000000 AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(Duration)/1000000 AS p95_ms, quantile(0.99)(Duration)/1000000 AS p99_ms FROM otel.traces WHERE Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime AND ServiceName IN ($service) GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName, count() AS spans FROM otel.traces WHERE Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime AND ServiceName IN ($service) GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time

SELECT TraceId, ServiceName, SpanName, Duration/1000000 AS duration_ms, StatusCode FROM otel.traces WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ServiceName IN ($service) ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 25
